name: agent-native
description: A framework for building agentic apps
one_liner: A toolkit for building apps where an AI assistant and a normal on-screen interface both use the exact same buttons and actions, so nothing gets out of sync.
buyer: A startup CTO building a SaaS product who wants to bolt an AI chat assistant onto their app without maintaining two separate code paths.
business_use_cases: A project-management SaaS adds 'ask the assistant to reschedule this sprint' by wiring the same action the UI button already calls.
An internal-tools team builds an ops dashboard where employees can either click through screens or delegate the same tasks to an agent.
An agency spins up client MVPs faster by starting from one of the included open-source agent apps (Clips, Design, Slides) as a template.

money_ideas.idea: Build a vertical SaaS product (e.g. an agent-native CRM or support desk) on top of the framework.
Offer 'add an AI copilot to your existing app' as a fixed-scope implementation service for other startups.

steal_this: Clone one of the included example apps (like the Slides agent) and re-skin it for a specific niche, e.g. real-estate listing decks, and sell it as a subscription tool this weekend.
